reason: The auger can open a well in the resource ice, and it is the only offered action.
expectation: I expect it to drill an access hole for extracting water.

effect: The borehole gives the extraction equipment access to the ice, as expected.
reaction: A straightforward first step; nothing surprising yet.
reason: The heating lance seems suited to melting ice in the borehole, and it is the only combination offered.
expectation: I expect a heated well or meltwater source.

effect: The borehole is now a heated extraction well, ready to connect to the rest of the supply.
reaction: The sequence makes physical sense, though it has been very directed.
reason: The hose should carry water from the well toward treatment; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the hose to connect to the well and provide a way to move water.

effect: The hose reaches the processor and completes the delivery goal; now the supply needs treatment.
reaction: Seeing the sealed run connect well and cabin is satisfying, though the result is expected.
reason: The earlier test showed cloth catches grit, so filtering the connected supply seems useful; it is the only combination offered.
expectation: I expect the line to deliver water with grit removed, but dissolved salts will still need treatment.

effect: The well water is clarified; the processor remains necessary for the potable supply.
reaction: The result follows the earlier filter demonstration, but offers little new detail.
reason: The processor should remove remaining dissolved contaminants, and this is the only combination offered.
expectation: I expect treated potable water, with some explanation of how the processor handles the dissolved salts.

effect: The processor produced drinking water and completed the supply, though its method remains unexplained.
reaction: The nearly tasteless first cup is a pleasing concrete payoff; I am curious how the salts were removed.

mostWorthwhile.text: The first cup made the practical achievement tangible and gave the sequence a human payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: The intermediate borehole and heating steps were predictable and offered no choices or detail beyond their names.

surprise.text: The final sensory description made water tasting of almost nothing feel like an achievement, although the processor's method was left unexplained.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, but every step offered just one combination, so I was following a procedure rather than making meaningful decisions.

continue.text: I would probably continue for the scientific discoveries and the larger expedition, though this chapter's linear procedure alone did not engage me much.
